去.o: Depicts opening the mouth (口) wide (大) to let a yawn leave the mouth. Original form of 呿.
w: to go down; to descend; to go on
x: 他到办公室去请假。
Tā dào bàngōngshì qù qǐngjià.
He went to the office to ask for leave.
她对男朋友的过去非常介意。
Tā duì nánpéngyou de guòqù fēicháng jièyì.
She is very bothered by her boyfriend's past.
她去年嫁给了大学同学。
Tā qùnián jià gěi le dàxué tóngxué.
She married her university classmate last year.

隻.o: Depicts a hand (又) holding a bird (隹). 隻 is used as a measure word for birds, as well as some other animals and objects.

主.o: Pictograph of a memorial tablet used for spiritual rituals, similar to 示.
x: 水土流失是这个地区农业生产面临的一个主要问题。
Shuǐtǔ liúshī shì zhège dìqū nóngyè shēngchǎn miànlín de yī gè zhǔyào wèntí.
Erosion is a major issue faced by agricultural production in this region.
这主意听起来不错。
Zhè zhǔyì tīngqǐlai bùcuò.
That sounds like a good idea.
今天开会是你的主席。
Jīntiān kāihuì shì nǐ de zhǔxí.
You will chair today's meeting.

死.o: Depicts using a digging tool (歹) to bury a person (人). Based on the original meaning "to bury a person". The meaning of this character has shifted over time and now means "die".
w: dead person; to die; (of a death) to happen
x: 你就死了这条心吧。
Nǐ jiù sǐ le zhè tiáo xīn ba.
Just drop it.
死亡不是生命的终点，遗忘才是。
Sǐwáng bù shì shēngmìng de zhōngdiǎn, yíwàng cái shì.
Death is not the end of life; forgetting is.
应该废除死刑吗？
Yīnggāi fèichú sǐxíng ma?
Should the death penalty be abolished?

電.o: Depicts lightning (申) during a rainstorm (雨).

c.h: 亻 is a component form of 人.

任.o: Phonosemantic compound. 亻 represents the meaning and 壬 represents the sound.
w: to trust; to have confidence in
trust to, rely on, appoint; allow
to hold a governmental office or post
x: 不要对任何人期望太高。
Bùyào duì rènhé rén qīwàng tài gāo.
Don't expect too much from anyone.
谁能承担这个责任呢？
Shéi néng chéngdān zhège zérèn ne?
Who can bear this responsibility?
任何事情都要讲究证据。
Rènhé shìqíng dōu yào jiǎngjiu zhèngjù.
In all matters one must pay attention to the evidence.

c.h: 氵 is a component form of 水.
Later reanalyzed as the visually similar character 舌.

活.o: Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 𠯑 represents the sound.
w: to exercise; to move about; to operate
x: 商品精了，价格活了，心情越来越好。
Shāngpǐn jīng le, jiàgé huó le, xīnqíng yuèláiyuè hǎo.
Products are top-notch and prices are flexible; I'm feeling better and better.
我们都向往幸福的生活。
Wǒmen dōu xiàngwǎng xìngfú de shēnghuó.
We all long for a happy life.
我跟你一块去干活。
Wǒ gēn nǐ yīkuài qù gànhuó.
I will go to work with you.

系.o: Pictograph of a hand (又) holding a group of threads (糸) that are connected together (系).
w: a series of; a string of
x: 其母系北京人。
Qí mǔ xì Běijīngrén.
His mother is a native of Beijing.
这笔记本儿什么系统的啊？
Zhèi bǐjìběnr shénme xìtǒng de a?
What is the operating system of this laptop?
没关系，下次注意就是了。
Méi guānxi, xiàcì zhùyì jiù shì le.
No problem, just be careful next time.

离.o: Simplified form of 離. Depicts a bird (隹) being caught in a bird trap (罕). Based on the original meaning "catch a bird". The meaning later shifted to "reject", "separate", and "leave". The 隹 (bird) component was removed for simplification.
w: to be far from; to keep away from
to separate oneself from; to break away from
x: 请你立刻离开。
Qǐng nǐ lìkè líkāi.
Please leave immediately.
请你远离我的生活！
Qǐng nǐ yuǎnlí wǒ de shēnghuó!
Please stay out of my life!
我几乎未曾离开过这个城市。
Wǒ jīhū wèicéng líkāi guò zhège chéngshì.
I have hardly ever been out of this city.

总.o: Simplified form of 總. Phonosemantic compound. 糹 represents the meaning and 悤 represents the sound. Based on the original meaning "bind together", since thread (糹) is used to put things together.
w: in a word; in short; in brief
to sum up; to conclude; summary
x: 你的朋友总是说脏话。
Nǐ de péngyǒu zǒngshì shuō zānghuà.
Your friend always uses foul language.
投资总是有风险因素。
Tóuzī zǒngshì yǒu fēngxiǎn yīnsù.
There is always an element of risk when making an investment.

c.h: 氵 is a component form of 水.

治.o: Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 台 represents the sound. Originally referred to a river in Shandong province. The current meaning is a phonetic loan.
w: to rule (a country); to govern; rule
to govern; to administer; to manage
x: 哎呦！可有人治治这个贱货了！
Āiyou! Kě yǒurén zhìzhi zhè ge jiànhuò le!
Ah! Finally there is someone to teach this nasty person a lesson!
她在政治上有很大的野心。
Tā zài zhèngzhì shàng yǒu hěn dà de yěxīn.
She has great political ambitions.
有些病况起因很明显，但治愈却很费时。
Yǒuxiē bìngkuàng qǐyīn hěn míngxiǎn, dàn zhìyù què hěn fèishí.
The causes of some conditions are obvious, yet time-consuming to cure.

卻.o: Phonosemantic compound. 卩 represents the meaning and 谷 represents the sound.

医.o: Originally depicted a quiver, a container for arrows. Later repurposed to mean "medicine" as a simplified form of the traditional character 醫.
w: medicine; medical science; study of medicine
x: 医生在给病人看病。
Yīshēng zài gěi bìngrén kànbìng.
The doctor is seeing a patient.
伤者已被送往医院。
Shāngzhě yǐ bèi sòng wǎng yīyuàn.
The injured have been taken to hospital.
医生说手术会有风险。
Yīshēng shuō shǒushù huì yǒu fēngxiǎn.
The doctor said the operation carries risks.

c.h: Shorthand for 頪, the sound component in the traditional character 頪.
Shorthand for 犬, the meaning component in the traditional character 頪.

类.o: Simplified form of 類. Phonosemantic compound. 犬 represents the meaning and 頪 represents the sound.
x: 由所有集合构成的类不是集合。
Yóu suǒyǒu jíhé gòuchéng de lèi bùshì jíhé.
The class of all sets is not a set.
书籍是人类进步的阶梯。
Shūjí shì rénlèi jìnbù de jiētī.
The book is the ladder of human progress.
陕西面食的种类和花样真多。
Shǎnxī miànshí de zhǒnglèi hé huāyàng zhēn duō.
In Shaanxi there are so many different kinds and variations of food made from wheat.

须.o: Pictograph of a person with a bearded face. Simplified form of 須. The meaning "must" is a phonetic loan.
w: must, have to, necessary; moment; whiskers
need not; not obliged to; not necessarily
x: 没有船票的人必须购票。
Méiyǒu chuánpiào de rén bìxū gòupiào.
Those without a boat ticket must purchase one.
这道坎必须得过。
Zhè dào kǎn bìxū děi guò.
You must go through this.

c.h: This component was deleted for simplification.

击.o: Simplified form of 擊. Based on the cursive form of the phonetic component 毄.
w: to attack; to accuse; to charge
to hit; to strike; to attack
to hit (a target etc); to strike
x: 这次考试不及格对他的打击很大。
Zhè cì kǎoshì bù jígé duì tā de dǎjī hěn dà.
Failing the exam this time was a great blow to his confidence.
导弹成功击中目标。
Dǎodàn chénggōng jīzhòng mùbiāo.
The missile successfully hit the target.

註.o: Phonosemantic compound. 言 represents the meaning and 主 represents the sound.

轻.o: Simplified form of 輕. Phonosemantic compound. 車 represents the meaning and 𢀖 represents the sound.
w: to lighten; to ease; to alleviate
x: 其实我觉得吧，他还是太年轻了。
Qíshí wǒ juéde ba, tā háishì tài niánqīng le.
Actually, I think he is still too young.
他在年轻人中间很有影响。
Tā zài niánqīngrén zhōngjiān hěn yǒu yǐngxiǎng.
He is very influential among young people.

c.h: In ancient China shells were used as currency.

費.o: Phonosemantic compound. 貝 represents the meaning and 弗 represents the sound.

緻.o: Phonosemantic compound. 糹 represents the meaning and 致 represents the sound.

麻.o: Depicts hemp leaves (𣏟) growing under a cliff (厂). The cliff (厂) component was later written as 广.
x: 我的腿都坐麻了。
Wǒ de tuǐ dōu zuò má le.
My legs have gone numb while sitting.
这事还真成了麻烦了。
Zhè shì hái zhēn chéng le máfan le.
This has really become a problem.
麻烦大家过来一下。
Máfan dàjiā guòlái yīxià.
Could everyone please come here?

c.h: 攵 is a component form of 攴.

攻.o: Phonosemantic compound. 攵 represents the meaning and 工 represents the sound.
w: to attack; to accuse; to charge
to attack; to assault; to go on the offensive
to capture; to take; to overcome
x: 两军协力去进攻敌人。
Liǎng jūn xiélì qù jìngōng dírén.
The two armies joined forces to attack the enemy.
这位医师专攻泌尿科。
Zhè wèi yīshī zhuāngōng mìniàokē.
This physician specialises in urology.

c.h: 刂 is a component form of 刀.

刻.o: Phonosemantic compound. 刂 represents the meaning and 亥 represents the sound.
w: short period of time; a moment
x: 科学技术时刻都在进步。
Kēxué jìshù shíkè dōu zài jìnbù.
Science and technology is constantly improving.
这段经历给我留下了深刻的印象。
Zhè duàn jīnglì gěi wǒ liúxià le shēnkè de yìnxiàng.
This experience left a deep impression on me.

c.h: Depicts a hand grabbing a woman's hair.

妻.o: Pictograph of a hand grabbing a woman's hair to take her as a wife. In ancient China, women of marriageable age wore hairpins (compare with 每).
w: a good wife and loving mother
wives and concubines (of a polygamous man)
x: 他有一个妻子和两个孩子要养活。
Tā yǒu yī ge qīzi hé liǎng ge háizi yào yǎnghuó.
He has a wife and two young children to provide for.
他是通过电脑红娘认识他妻子的。
Tā shì tōngguò diànnǎo hóngniáng rènshi tā qīzi de.
He met his wife through a computer dating agency.

c.h: 讠 is a component form of 言.
Simplified from the 𧸇 component in the traditional character 讀.

读.o: Phonosemantic compound. 讠 represents the meaning and 𧸇 represents the sound. Simplified form of 讀.
w: to read a book; to study; to attend school
to decipher; to decode; to interpret
to read out loud to an audience
x: 这篇文章值得一读。
Zhè piān wénzhāng zhíde yī dú.
This article is worth reading.
读书破万卷，下笔如有神。
Dúshū pò wàn juàn, xiàbǐ rú yǒu shén.
Great writers read widely.
虽然我的阅读水平很好，但是跟中国人讲话有点困难。
Suīrán wǒ de yuèdú shuǐpíng hěn hǎo, dànshì gēn zhōngguórén jiǎnghuà yǒudiǎn kùnnán.
Although my reading skills are very good, I have some difficulty conversing with Chinese people.

画.o: Pictograph of a hand holding a writing utensil (聿) and drawing something. The 聿 component was deleted for simplification.
w: a painting, picture, drawing; to draw
x: 中国传统绘画盛行至今。
Zhōngguó chuántǒng huìhuà shèngxíng zhìjīn.
Traditional Chinese painting is popular to this day.
她把电脑画面投放到电视上。
Tā bǎ diànnǎo huàmiàn tóufàng dào diànshì shàng.
She projects the computer screen to a television.

c.h: 亻 is a component form of 人.

傻.o: Depicts a person (亻) with a gap in their skull (𡕩), i.e. with no brains.
w: to giggle; to laugh foolishly; to smirk
to act stupid; to pretend to be naive
x: 请你不要把我当傻子。
Qǐng nǐ bùyào bǎ wǒ dànɡ shǎzi.
Please don't treat me like a fool.
瞧他那个傻样儿。
Qiáo tā nàge shǎ yàngr.
Look at how silly he looks.

c.h: Shorthand for the 食 component in the traditional character 養.

养.o: Simplified form of 養. Phonosemantic compound. 食 represents the meaning and 羊 represents the sound.
rad: “ears-out” component used in some Chinese characters (e.g. U+5151 兑)
w: to cultivate; to breed; to foster
to take in and care for (an elderly person, a dog etc)
to foster; to bring up; to raise
to provide for the elderly (family members)
x: 他是奶奶养大的。
Tā shì nǎinai yǎng dà de.
He was raised by his grandma.
速食面虽然方便，但没有营养。
Sùshímiàn suīrán fāngbiàn, dàn méiyǒu yíngyǎng.
Instant noodles might be convenient, but they do not have much nutritional value.

闻.o: Phonosemantic compound. 耳 represents the meaning and 门 represents the sound. Simplified form of 聞.
w: to smell; to sniff sth out
to have heard what was said
x: 你有没有听说过女权主义者焚烧胸罩的传闻？
Nǐ yǒu méi yǒu tīngshuō guò nǚquánzhǔyìzhě fénshāo xiōngzhào de chuánwén?
Have you heard the urban legend about the feminists who set their bras on fire?
这所私立大学以商学院闻名。
Zhè suǒ sīlì dàxué yǐ shāngxuéyuàn wénmíng.
This private university is well-known for its business school.

登.o: Depicts two feet (癶) rising onto a stone platform (豆) to board into a vehicle.
w: to go on stage; fig. to appear on the scene
to climb over; to ascend onto; to mount
x: 请留意您乘坐航班的登机时间，以免误机。
Qǐng liúyì nín chéngzuò hángbān de dēngjī shíjiān, yǐmiǎn wùjī.
Please pay attention to the boarding time so you don't miss your flight.
就不登录怎么地了？
Jiù bù dēnglù zěnmedì le?
What are you going to do if I just don't log in?

移.o: Phonosemantic compound. 禾 represents the meaning and 多 represents the sound. Alludes to grain moving while it is blown by the wind.
x: 哪个国家好移民？
Nǎge guójiā hǎo yímín?
Which country is easy to immigrate to?
为什么那么多移民选择加拿大？
Wèishénme nàme duō yímín xuǎnzé Jiānádà?
Why do so many migrants choose Canada?

寻.o: Simplified form of 尋. Pictograph of two outstretched arms measuring length. The current meaning is a phonetic loan.
w: to look for; to seek; to find fault
to pursue; to track down; to search
x: 他四处寻找丢失的钥匙。
Tā sìchù xúnzhǎo diūshī de yàoshi.
He looked here and there for the missing keys.
别拿我寻开心！
Bié ná wǒ xún kāixīn!
Don't make fun of me!

c.h: 阝 is a component form of 阜.

阻.o: Phonosemantic compound. 阝 represents the meaning and 且 represents the sound.
w: to obstruct; to hinder; to block
to stop; to resist; to obstruct
to block; to obstruct; to intercept
x: 我想阻止他，可是太晚了。
Wǒ xiǎng zǔzhǐ tā, kěshì tài wǎn le.
I wanted to stop him, but it was too late.
大雪阻碍了交通。
Dàxuě zǔ'ài le jiāotōng.
The heavy snow disrupted traffic.

翻.o: Phonosemantic compound. 羽 represents the meaning and 番 represents the sound.
w: to turn over (when lying); to free oneself
to revamp; a face-lift; to retread (a tire)
x: 会议室设置了同步翻译的设备。
Huìyìshì shèzhì le tóngbù fānyì de shèbèi.
The conference room is equipped with synchronous translation facilities.
赵元任译的《阿丽思漫游奇境记》属于「归化翻译」。
Zhào Yuánrèn yì de “Ālìsī Mànyóu Qíjìngjì” shǔyú “guīhuà fānyì”.
Chao Yuen Ren's translation of Alice's Adventures in Wonderland is a domesticated translation.

吻.o: Phonosemantic compound. 口 represents the meaning and 勿 represents the sound. Simplified form of 脗.
w: to be a good fit; to be identical with
tone of voice; connotation in intonation
x: 我给我老婆一个飞吻。
Wǒ gěi wǒ lǎopo yī ge fēiwěn.
I blew a kiss to my wife.
我跟他舌吻了。
Wǒ gēn tā shéwěn le.
I French kissed him.
墨尔本天气变幻莫测；人们都说这里一日四季。
Mò'ěrběn tiānqì biànhuànmòcè; rénmen dōu shuō zhèlǐ yī rì sì jì.
Melbourne's weather is unpredictable; they say it has four seasons in one day.

獻.o: Depicts a dog (犬) in a boiler (鬳) being offered as a sacrifice.

墻.o: Phonosemantic compound. 土 represents the meaning and 嗇 represents the sound.

c.h: 彳 is a component form of 行.

彻.o: Phonosemantic compound. 彳 represents the meaning and 切 represents the sound. Simplified form of 徹.
w: to implement; to put into practice
lit. from head to tail (idiom); thoroughgoing
x: 房间已经彻底打扫干净了。
Fángjiān yǐjīng chèdǐ dǎsǎo gānjìng le.
The room has been thoroughly cleaned.
老师把这个问题讲得很透彻。
Lǎoshī bǎ zhège wèntí jiǎng de hěn tòuchè.
The teacher explained this question very thoroughly.

驻.o: Phonosemantic compound. 马 represents the meaning and 主 represents the sound. Simplified form of 駐.
w: to be stationed at, reside at; to stop
to dispatch (sb) in an official capacity
x: 很多游客在这里驻足拍照。
Hěn duō yóukè zài zhèlǐ zhùzú pāizhào.
Many tourists stop here to take photos.

鼻.o: Phonosemantic compound. 自 is a pictograph of a nose and 畀 represents the sound.
w: to assail the nostrils; acrid; pungent
x: 大象有着长长的鼻子。
Dàxiàng yǒuzhe chángcháng de bízi.
Elephants have long trunks.
大象有著长长的鼻子。
Dàxiàng yǒuzhe chángcháng de bízi.
Elephants have long trunks.

c.h: 钅 is a component form of 金.

钻.o: Phonosemantic compound. 钅 represents the meaning and 占 represents the sound. Simplified form of 鑽.
w: to get into; to dig into (studies, job etc)
to study meticulously; to delve into
to bore a hole; to drill; drilled hole
to drill (e.g. for oil); a borehole
x: 他在墙上钻了一个孔。
Tā zài qiáng shàng zuān le yí ge kǒng.
He drilled a hole in the wall.
这种钻不适合打混凝土。
Zhè zhǒng zuàn bù shìhé dǎ hùnníngtǔ.
This kind of drill isn't suitable for concrete.

c.h: Depicts a head on top of a person.

頻.o: Depicts a person standing (頁) on the shore wading (涉) in shallow water. Based on the original meaning "riverside", now written as 瀕. The meaning later shifted to "continuous" and "repeatedly".

姻.o: Phonosemantic compound. 女 represents the meaning and 因 represents the sound.
x: 婚姻是爱情的坟墓。
Hūnyīn shì àiqíng de fénmù.
Marriage is the tomb of love. (saying)
他的婚姻瓦解了。
Tā de hūnyīn wǎjiě le.
His marriage fell apart.

c.h: 阝 is a component form of 阜.

邻.o: Phonosemantic compound. 阝 represents the meaning and 令 represents the sound. Simplified form of 鄰.
x: 他指控我谋杀邻居。
Tā zhǐkòng wǒ móushā línjū.
He accused me of murdering my neighbour.
中国和日本是一衣带水的邻邦。
Zhōngguó hé Rìběn shì yīyīdàishuǐ de línbāng.
China and Japan are neighbouring countries separated only by a narrow strip of water.

c.h: 辶 is a component form of 辵.

逻.o: Phonosemantic compound. 辶 represents the meaning and 罗 represents the sound. Simplified form of 邏.
x: 这是什么逻辑？
Zhè shì shénme luójí?
What kind of logic is that?

c.h: 冫 is a component form of 冰.

冻.o: Phonosemantic compound. 冫 represents the meaning and 东 represents the sound. Simplified form of 凍.
w: to freeze to death; to die off in winter
to melt; to thaw; to defrost
x: 今天太冷了，双手冻直了。
Jīntiān tài lěng le, shuāngshǒu dòng zhí le.
Today's so cold, my two hands are frozen numb.
她手指冻木了。
Tā shǒuzhǐ dòng mù le.
Her fingers were numb with cold.

玻.o: Phonosemantic compound. 王 represents the meaning and 皮 represents the sound.
x: 他一不小心被玻璃丝划破了手。
Tā yībùxiǎoxīn bèi bōlísī huápò le shǒu.
He accidentally cut his hand on the glass silk.
小心玻璃。
Xiǎoxīn bōli.
Caution — glass door.

耻.o: Phonosemantic compound. 耳 represents the meaning and 止 represents the sound. Simplified form of 恥.
w: without any sense of shame; unembarrassed
honor and shame; sense of honor
national humiliation, refers to Japanese incursions into China in…
to sneer at sb; to ridicule
